description: Vue builds a page from small parts called components. It connects values to the page and updates the page when those values change. Start with a greeting, then add choices, lists and a little memory. Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.
versionNote: Uses Vue 3 Single-File Components and the Composition API with script setup.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to start the counter at 5 instead of 0
Learn to add a third book with a new id
Learn to change the value sent with the choose event
learningObjectives: Learn to start the counter at 5 instead of 0
Learn to add a third book with a new id
Learn to change the value sent with the choose event
